text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I couldn't do it... I lost!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can't believe I thought I could follow
in Air
Groove's footsteps. I'm not even at
the point
where I can chase after her
yet...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can't even get close to her, no matter
how hard
I try! She's just getting farther
and farther away!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to accomplish anything at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I must become like Air Groove! I can't
build a
new legacy if I don't!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I have to do something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to race in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober makes her declaration the
moment
she returns to the waiting room,
her expression
filled with desperation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This race made it clear... If I can't win
here, how
can I expect to win anywhere
else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But this isn't the time to be getting
depressed. I'm
not the same person I was
after the Arima Kinen.
I'm going to keep
fighting this battle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No doubt Air Groove will be running in
the spring
Grand Prix—the Takarazuka
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And if that's the case, then I'm running
in it too! I
have to face off against her
again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have to figure out what's preventing me
from
becoming like her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's that feeling again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That same strange sense of unease I've

experienced before rattles loudly in my
chest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My lips part, and before I know it, a
question
spills forth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?
choice_data_list: Are you really sure about that?
Are you really fine with that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no point asking her such a thing
when I
myself can't put what I'm feeling
into words yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to think this through and find an
answer...
Only then can I talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You're so weird.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In any case, our next goal is
decided—she'll be
running the
Takarazuka Kinen.
